personality_one_liner: A highly touchable, high-contrast, strictly utilitarian interface designed for semi-literate field workers.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing everywhere. screenPadding 16, headerHeight 72, bottomTabHeight 72.

dont's: No glassmorphism for this app. It requires solid, high-contrast, flat industrial utility to avoid confusing semi-literate workers.

screens.name: Authentication & Onboarding
screens.purpose: Language picker -> Phone+OTP -> Self-Registration with selfie.
screens.layout: Language Picker: 3 massive pill buttons. OTP: 6 large boxes (auto-submit). Registration: single column form -> 13-category icon grid for department -> full screen selfie capture with face guide overlay.

screens.name: Home Hub
screens.layout: Header: 72px tall, App name, User first name + dept chip, Selfie thumbnail avatar. TOP: full-width Red Incident Report tile (120px height, siren icon). BELOW: 2-column grid with Attendance, My Reports, My Shift, Notifications (badge). 16px screen padding.

screens.name: Incident Reporting
screens.layout: Step 1: 8-category circle grid (110px circles) with icon + label. Step 2: Full-screen camera with 88px shutter and GPS chip overlay. Step 3: Watermarked preview + big submit CTA. Success: Big green check, auto-returns to home after 3s.

screens.name: Attendance
screens.purpose: GPS+selfie punch-in/out and month calendar view.
screens.layout: Punch view: Front camera with face guide -> verifies -> displays Result Badge (Verified+ Green, Verified Blue, Flagged Amber). Calendar view: Heatmap grid of dates (DD/MM/YYYY, 12-hour) with status colors.

screens.name: My Reports & Notifications
screens.purpose: Track submitted issues and read alerts.
screens.layout: List view with status chips on each row. Generous 56px minimum touch targets per row.

instructions_to_main_agent: STRICT ADHERENCE TO TOKENS: Colors: primary teal #0B4F6C, accent blue #3A5DAE, success #22C55E, danger #E85A6F, warning #F59E0B, background #F9F8F5, border #D4D1CA, text #28251D, muted #7A7974.
STRICT ADHERENCE TO SIZES: screenPadding 16, headerHeight 72, bottomTabHeight 72, minimum touch target 56px EVERYWHERE, incident tile height 120, category circle 110, FAB 56, camera shutter 88.
Typography: Use Baloo 2 font as requested. Keep the font size scale generous (base 16) for semi-literate users.
For semi-literate users: EVERY action MUST have a big button with an ICON + LABEL. Never use icon-only buttons. Minimize reading; use high contrast and big visual cues.
Home Screen Layout: Top element MUST be a full-width red 'Incident Report' tile (120px height) using the 'danger' color #E85A6F. Below it, a 2-column grid.
Incident Category Grid: Must contain exactly 8 circles of 110px size with icon and trilingual label.
Attendance Badges: Use specific colors: Verified+ (Green #22C55E), Verified (Blue #3A5DAE), Flagged (Amber #F59E0B). Do not use red for flagged.
No glassmorphism. This app requires solid backgrounds and crisp contrast for factory environments.
